newsitem.title: USA: General Growth buys mall for $32 million.
newsitem.headline: General Growth buys mall for $32 million.

text.p: General Growth Properties Inc said Thursday it acquired Century Plaza in Birmingham, Alabama, from a private investor for $32 million.
The property is expected to produce about $3.5 million of net operating income during the next 12 months, General Growth said.

Century Plaza, initially opened in 1975, is a single-level mall of about 746,000 square feet of gross leasable area located on a 63-acre tract. The center is currently 68 percent occupied and generates sales of about $240 per square foot, General Growth said, adding that it hopes to remerchandise and further improve the performance of the mall over the next few years.
General Growth is a real estate investment trust that owns and develops shopping centers. Its shares closed up 1/4 at 32-1/8 Thursday.
